row.Title: Technical Data Sheet Eastar copolyester 6763
row.Source note: Eastman's own technical data sheet for Eastar copolyester 6763, a web page of its product catalogue saved as served ("Eastar 6763 is a clear, amorphous material"). Eastman publishes no PDF of it: its "Print or save as PDF" button prints the page. Kept as the polymer reference of PETG (polymers.csv): density, specific gravity, water absorption and glass transition of injection-moulded bars.
